claims.summary: Dataset schema v4 validates the exact frozen five-domain benchmark before admitting or splitting any training row and fails closed on unavailable, linked, malformed, or invalid benchmark input.
Held-out domain rows and held-out course IDs are quarantined before deduplication or split assignment, including a frozen course relabeled under a training domain.
Dataset identity v2 binds the frozen benchmark receipt and records domain-plus-course and course-ID-only group hashes alongside exact sources, evidence distributions, and split bytes.
Training reopens and validates the exact benchmark, rejects digest or separation drift, and the paired evaluator requires the same course-ID-only proof before a held-out run.

A reproducible tracked audit finds 75 of 418 stored rows structurally usable across four domains and five groups, zero admissible single-model-judge preferences, and a smoke-only lane with no trained or promoted adapter.
